title: Tinderwick - Embers Banked Low
_note: Mood sibling: melancholy lean. gbc 4-voice, no chords. 80 BPM, 6/8, A minor leaning to relative C major only at the very last bar. Lead = Vesper contour CONTRACTED - the hopeful leap undershoots and lingers, more sigh than lift (E3->A3->B3 reaching, then sagging back). Harmony = slow rolling 6/8 arpeggio, fewer notes, more air. Bass = gentle dotted 6/8 lilt, like slow breathing. Percussion = none / one felt brush at phrase ends. 16 bars 6/8.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Contracted Vesper: the lift reaches E3->A3->B3 then sighs back instead of overshooting; settle sags. 6/8: each bar two dotted-quarter pulses. Final bar lifts toward C (relative major) and to E (V of Am) to lead back.
